title: Best Todo app so far
body: Using the version downloaded from the web almost daily to organise different areas and goals. Love being able to push items up and down quickly. UI (especially choice of fonts for titles, and the calendar view) could use an overhaul, but a new version seems to be coming out soon. One feature that missing is being able to make the app much smaller.
author: e.jls.w

title: This App is what I was searching for!!!
body:
Tbh I was a bit overwhelmed at the beginning - it is totally different than other tools (esp. Apple’s) BUT this is its value! 

It just makes fun to understand the features of this app, whilst being not overstimulated by just doing the task! 

Once I understood the main features, I can see myself investing in this app to support further development / updates! But the functionality is just amaaaaaziinnggg 🤩 personal CRM, Habits, journal, Tasks, Notes, Goals etc etc etc 🤩🤩🤩 this is app needs to be the mandatory for every phone! This needs to be shared to everyone!

Really well done and thank you for a good European alternative (esp. with encryption)! 

Best wishes from Germany
author: XJacksonXx

title: Suchfunktion verbesserungswürdig
body: Die App ist wunderbar, da sie alle Bereiche - Journaling, To-Do-list und Habit Tracker miteinander verbindet. Kontaktpflege und Details sind ein echtes Highlight. Einziger Schmerzpunkt: Die Suchfunktion findet nur Headlines, keine Inhalte (z.B. Journaleinträge nach Stichworten), das müsste verbessert werden
author: pippi.me

title: Cant buy the full version
body: It is reallyt user-friendly, so if you feel overwhelmed by other apps, this one is made to relax you. But, I can't pay for the full version, and the free version is really nothing to consider, you can only have 2 projects.
author: gjjftb

title: The only app that worked for me
body:
I've been using Lunatask over a year and it truly has everything that I was looking for. Plus the to-do list prioritization makes me not have to think too much what to do next. 

Thank you for making my life easier!
author: luzi0047
